task_type_paths.path_notes: --quick is a full pipeline bypass. The main 5-stage pipeline (Locate → Validate → Prepare → Plan → Present) is replaced by the quick/start.md workflow. No grooming, no RT-ICA, no groom swarm, no classifier, no add-new-feature. Produces a single-task plan with slug 'quick-{slug}'. If the fix scope overlaps an active plan, integrates as an appended task instead of creating a new plan.

task_type_paths.path_notes: --auto runs the same 5-stage pipeline (Locate → Validate → Prepare → Plan → then continues) but replaces all interactive decision points with logged autonomous decisions. It extends beyond interactive mode by automatically chaining implement-feature and complete-implementation, then closing the item. Hard stops on RT-ICA BLOCKED and feasibility BLOCKED are preserved. Does not affect which issue type the classifier assigns — classification still runs during groom/Prepare.

_meta.note_on_downstream_differentiation: The issue type (defect/recurring-pattern/missing-guardrail/unbounded-design/procedural) affects ONLY the groom swarm phase: whether Root-Cause Analysis runs (defect/recurring-pattern only) and which analysis method is recorded. The type is stored in the Issue Classification section of the backlog item. No source attests that add-new-feature, implement-feature, or complete-implementation branch differently based on issue type. The downstream path (Prepare → Plan → implement-feature → complete-implementation) is identical for all five classifier types.
_meta.complete_implementation_path_split: complete-implementation has two paths: (1) SAM path — item has a linked plan (the plan address is the input); (2) Proportional Quality Gates (PQG) path — item has no linked plan (runs 5 tasks: Code Review, Test Verification, Acceptance Check, Documentation Drift Audit, Documentation Update). This split is based on whether a plan exists, NOT on issue type.
